# MCCE

> MCCE is the M.S. in Computer and Communication Engineering, a two-year graduate program in the Department of Computer and Communications Engineering at Lebanese International University (LIU). This site is an independent, student-built materials browser for the program: it indexes course files from the program's shared drive so they can be searched and browsed by semester, course, and file type.

This site is not an official LIU page. For admissions, curriculum, and official program details, see the official program page linked below.

## Program facts

- Program: M.S. in Computer and Communication Engineering (MCCE)
- Department: Department of Computer and Communications Engineering (CCE)
- University: Lebanese International University (LIU)
- Duration: Two years, combining coursework with a research project
- Focus areas: telecommunications, data communications, network architecture, wireless systems, optical networking

## Curriculum

- CENG507: Embedded Systems
- EENG527: Digital Signal Processing
- EENG537: Digital Communications
- ENGG515: Advanced Engineering Mathematics
- CENG557: Advanced Network Architectures
- EENG587: Wireless Communication
- CENG675: Multimedia Networks
- CENG566: Machine Learning
- CENG566L: Machine Learning Laboratory
- CENG695A: Master Thesis Project (Part I)
- ENGG550: Engineering Project Management and Control
- CENG625: Cryptography & Advanced Computer Security
- CENG645: Mobile Communication
- CENG646: Data Mining
- CENG695B: Master Thesis Project (Part II)
- CENG685: Information Security
- CENG678: Image Processing and Computer Vision
- CENG679: Satellite and Space Communications

Each course has its own page at `https://mcce.khaledsaeed.tech/course/{code}`, for example [CENG557](https://mcce.khaledsaeed.tech/course/CENG557).

## Frequently asked

- What does MCCE stand for? M.S. in Computer and Communication Engineering, a two-year graduate program at LIU.
- Is this site official? No. It is an independent, student-built materials browser, not affiliated with LIU.
- How current is the material? The index re-syncs from the shared Drive automatically about once a week.
- Do I need an account? Not for the site itself. Files open in Google Drive using your own Google account.
- Can I add materials I have? Yes, through the contact page.

See [the full FAQ](https://mcce.khaledsaeed.tech/faq) for more.

## Admissions

- Applications should be submitted before the end of September and before the end of the first week of the fall semester.
- LIU bachelor graduates need a major GPA and a cumulative GPA of at least 2.0.
- Bachelor graduates from other recognized institutions need a major GPA of at least 2.25.
- Non-LIU applicants sit an English entrance exam and submit certified copies of their baccalaureate, degree, and transcript.
- Application fee: $50, non-refundable. English entrance exam fee: $20.
- The School of Engineering typically returns acceptance or rejection within 72 hours of receiving a file.
- Official contacts: admissions@liu.edu.lb, soe@liu.edu.lb, info@liu.edu.lb.

See [the admissions guide](https://mcce.khaledsaeed.tech/admissions) for the full flow.

## Tuition

Reference figures for the 2025/2026 academic year, subject to change without notice.

- $135 per credit, or 7,500,000 LBP per credit.
- Average load of 26 credits per year over two years.
- $3,510 per year in tuition, or 195,000,000 LBP per year.
- Registration fee: $150 per year. NSSF: 8,400,000 LBP per year, if applicable.
- Official source: https://liu.edu.lb/cms26/public/page.php?slug=tuition

See [tuition and fees](https://mcce.khaledsaeed.tech/tuition-fees) for a per semester planner.

## CCE undergraduate programs

The same department runs two bachelor programs. This site does not index their materials; it carries one reference page for them at https://mcce.khaledsaeed.tech/cce.

- B.S. in Computer Engineering (CENG): 108 credits, three years.
- B.S. in Communications Engineering (TENG, major code BTENG): 108 credits, three years.
- The two tracks share 40 of their 41 courses. CENG takes CENG470 Data Structures and Analysis of Algorithms; TENG takes EENG388 Electromagnetic Fields and Waves instead.
- CENG major electives: CENG460 Operating Systems and CENG470, 6 credits from a list of two, so both are taken.
- TENG major elective: 3 credits from CENG460 or CENG480 Introduction to GIS. CENG480 has not been opening, so the choice is CENG460.
- Both tracks take one general education elective, 3 credits, from a university-wide list that changes between terms.
- Official page: https://cce.liu.edu.lb/academic-programs/undergraduate-programs
